scope.summary: Wire automatic SDF fallback specifically for extreme-proportion bust/hip regions exceeding capsule capacity.
acceptance_criteria: Extreme proportions auto-switch the affected region to SDF collision.
Typed inputs, outputs, units, tolerances, invalid/non-finite behavior, and deterministic seed/order requirements are explicit; invalid input fails without mutating solver or authority state.
Boundary, degeneracy, cancellation, and repeatability tests prove the behavior through the owning SolverCapture or typed run receipt, including an evidence-bearing failure path.
scope.risk_if_missed: Capsules alone cannot collide extreme exaggerated bodies cleanly.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-UI scope: behavior remains observable through typed Tailor state, receipts, captures, diagnostics, and TraceProjection; GUI projection is verified by the owning native-shell MT.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Cloth collision, contact, and repair

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Pure computation or schema-only behavior has no independent lifecycle event; its owning run records inputs, outputs, diagnostics, and receipts.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
This bounded in-process computation has no application or child-process watch surface.

required_changes_before_execution: Upgrade collision from particle/proxy pushout to mesh VF/EE predictive contact, coupled layers, SDF freshness, independent triangle validation, explicit untangle, and adversarial reliability matrices while retaining analytic preview colliders and the exaggerated-body test intent.
Added gui_obligation, user_manual_obligation, and HBR-INT-009 tier obligations from the current MT template without removing original scope.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.
Use PostgreSQL RLS/FORCE RLS and ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; UI filtering is never the security boundary.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
